title: 선택 연도·체크 차수의 엑셀 다운로드 및 인쇄
productionSmoke: Manual workflow uses the existing configured service credential only for same-origin API GET/HEAD. All mutation requests are aborted. Reopens the actual downloaded single-week XLSX and uses the actual shared profitDisplayCalculation projection. On mismatch only whitelisted country-level values, absolute/relative delta and inventory valuation numeric metadata are logged; no raw payload, customer/person data, sources or credentials. Tolerance remains 1e-8. Temporary XLSX is removed; no business data artifact upload. See docs/plans/profit-live-output-consistency-2026-11-03.md.

outputPreferences.storage: browser localStorage; screen v4 starts with all22 once, thereafter explicit selections restored; legacy v3 and presets retained; output v1 explicit selection preserved, new default all22
rules: Restore before first persistence; empty selection preserved and output blocked
Same COLUMN_DEFS keys/order for screen and output picker; explicit copy-screen action
Excel and print both include checked majors only; initial current major, select-all means 1 through loaded major; empty selection blocked
Filename and sheet count reflect actual selected weeks including noncontiguous selections
No ERP/report calculation or ledger changes; changing selection invalidates pending print

printPresentation.policy: 2026-11-03 latest request supersedes print audit-prose requirement only. Keep exact userNote from !profitPrint metadata, all financial cells and null/zero meanings. Omit automatic status/audit/subtitle prose on paper only; keep XLSX audit and web verification unchanged. Do not regex-remove author text even if it contains status words.
printPresentation.layout: A4 landscape margin8mm, one chosen week per page, fit full table and note without cropping, numeric cells nowrap. Font-ready iframe load opens print dialog without an intermediate preview action. Failure/abort/stale selection produces no partial print.
printPresentation.keyboard: Viewport-clamped column picker, Escape restores trigger focus; checkbox Arrow/Home/End navigation and native Tab/Space.
printPresentation.sideEffects: No SQL/API/calculation changes, no DB/snapshot writes or refresh. Existing beforeOutput explicit-save guard preserved.

weeksViewOutput.scope: Only the successfully loaded explicit year/from/to. All loaded weeks initially selected; select-all never expands beyond loaded range. Category mode keeps its existing current-week default and 1..major choices.
weeksViewOutput.guards: Input mismatch, active load, dirty category edits, any failed/mismatched response, abort or obsolete request blocks output. Same-year/week response identity and request sequence checked before committing loaded scope. Input edits cancel in-flight output, including font-ready pending print. No save/confirm action exposed or automatically invoked in read-only weeks mode.
weeksViewOutput.printNote: Latest user request: print-only author note lines are trimmed, empty lines skipped, joined with middle-dot separators and wrapped horizontally. Original DB/XLSX/meta note unchanged; last item preserved. No automatic audit prose is added.

actions.name: REPORT_RANGE_OUTPUT_READ
actions.sideEffect: 명시적 연도/차수별 GET, 기존 live/확정 공용 읽기와 엑셀 생성 재사용. 엑셀과 인쇄 모두 체크한 차수만 숫자순으로 처리하며 차수당 한 시트/한 장. 전체 선택은1~조회차수, 초기값은 현재 차수 하나, 빈 선택은 차단. 출력 신규 기본은22열 전체이고 기존 명시 출력 선택은 보존한다. 화면 컬럼 가져오기는 명시 버튼으로 수행. 비고는 보존하며 인쇄에만 자동 상태설명 제외. HTTP502/503/504/네트워크 오류는 해당 GET만 최대2회 재시도하며 범위 오류/실패/취소에 부분파일 또는 부분인쇄 금지. 조회 전 연도/차수 입력 불일치 상태 출력 차단. ERP/Web 원장 및 계산/확정 snapshot 쓰기 없음. 기존 수기 초안은 기존 명시 저장 경로만 사용.

crossYearFixture.description: 동일 01차의 2025/2026 응답을 교차 혼용하지 않으며 누락연도, 범위밖차수, 중복응답, 응답연도변경, 실패, 취소를 실행 검사한다.

longNotePdfPolicy.fit: Layout-aware CSS zoom, never paint-only transform beneath overflow:hidden. Reset zoom before every measurement so repeated fitting is stable.
longNotePdfPolicy.verification: Synthetic >8533-character notes and actual selected production notes must preserve the entire exact whitespace-normalized string and last item on one A4 landscape page. No shortening, tail-only acceptance, source/PDF uploads or private note logging. Synthetic real-PDF preflight runs in the manual print workflow with Korean fonts before production GETs.
